user_query: I'm planning a family trip to a remote location with minimal light pollution. Can you recommend the best spot for stargazing based on the positions of celestial bodies? Also, provide me with the positions of these bodies for the date range from December 20, 2017, to December 21, 2017.

TaskList.description: Gather information on locations with minimal light pollution suitable for stargazing.
Obtain celestial body positions for the specified date range (December 20, 2017, to December 21, 2017).
Analyze the stargazing locations in conjunction with celestial body positions to recommend the best spot.
